content_chunk: All AI inference requests are isolated to VLAN 30 with strict outbound port blocking.
The perimeter firewall blocks inbound traffic by default and only approved services are allowed through explicit rules.
Office workstations on VLAN 10 reach the internet only through filtered egress with DNS logging enabled.
Management access on VLAN 99 is limited to a jump host with hardware-key authentication.
Inter-zone traffic between office and core services is limited to application ports with mutual TLS.
Air-gapped nodes have no WAN route and updates are applied from signed offline media only.
Initial provisioning uses a staging VLAN before the node is moved to VLAN 30 for production.
GPU drivers and model weights are checksummed before installation on isolated hosts.
Backup of the inference gateway runs to encrypted removable media stored offsite.
Physical access to the rack requires badge entry and all openings are logged.
The inference gateway listens on HTTPS 443 and serves only approved model endpoints.
Health checks run every thirty seconds and failed nodes are removed from rotation.
Request logs keep prompts for 7 days for abuse review, then they are purged.
Model reloads are staged and traffic shifts only after a smoke test passes.
Rate limits per client prevent a single office from saturating the GPU queue.
Confidential documents stay on core services and are never copied to workstations.
Email addresses and phone numbers are redacted from demo logs before storage.
Retention for lead data is 12 months unless erasure is requested by the owner.
Access to backups needs two approvals and all restores are recorded.
Demo queries must not include customer personal data or credentials.
Wi-Fi uses WPA3 enterprise with per-user credentials and monthly rotation.
Latency budgets target p95 under two seconds for cached prompts.
